0022600135.text: The Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East and 3rd in the Central, one game back) host the 76ers (3-1, 4th in the East and 2nd in the Atlantic) in their fifth game of the season, with Indiana at 0-1 at home and on a one-game losing streak. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Obi Toppin is day-to-day with a hand sprain and is a game-time decision. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Pacers lost 0-4 to the 76ers in 2025-26, including a 105-94 loss in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
